method: Monte Carlo model-based central 95% uncertainty interval
scenario_weighting: Industry: annual non-electric fuel with shared 2021 baseline; other sectors: equal probability per named structural path
activity_basis: Input activity errors: assumed 95% bounds 0.95/1.05 per sector-year; newly calibrated sectors use target/base-year ratios, with independent errors between years and a shared base-year error. Base-year activity error cancels. Proxy application and independence are analyst assumptions.
town_gas_factor_basis: Analyst assumption: local factor uncertainty unavailable; not an EPD reported confidence interval
crt_calibration_basis: One 2021 baseline multiplier per sector, shared across time; assumed 95% bounds ±10%
extrapolation_basis: Analyst assumption: independent yearly log-scale increments beyond the last benchmark, cumulative random walk
factor_basis: IPCC 2006 Volume 2 Chapter 1 Table 1.4. Coal treated as Other Bituminous Coal (fuel-type assumption). Lognormal fitted to the stated 2.5/97.5 percentiles; central factor need not be fitted median. Newly calibrated sectors apply the same fuel draw to numerator and baseline denominator; single-fuel constant factors cancel.
correlations: One draw per fuel EF shared across years/sectors. Structural choices shared across time for non-Industry sectors. Industry: one shared 2021 coefficient; target/base-year activity errors. Activity draws shared within sector-year. Transport CRT scale shared across time. Annual drift cumulative. Other input families independent by assumption; separate seeded streams for each sector. For Power, Residential, Commercial and international bunkers: every structural path is separately calibrated; fuel-factor errors normalized by its 2021 denominator and sector-year activity errors divided by shared 2021 activity error. Official baseline multiplier shared through time, independent across sectors by assumption.
held_fixed: monthly allocation errors beyond the chosen structural paths
